book_summary: High fantasy PBTA magical mecha rebellion. Characters represent Cause against oppressive Authority, sharing a Carrier, alternating Sorties, Conflict Turns and Downtime scenes. Fiction-first moves use 2d6 + Traits, 6-/7–9/10+, advantage/disadvantage up to 4 dice; confidence 1→6, desperation 6→1 before keep. Danger risks/perils lead to defenceless, burdens and death. Hooks and GRAVITY drive character growth. Eight playbooks: four Channelers, four Support. Astirs, equipment, tiers, approaches, Authority Divisions, Cause Factions and Pillars support strategic conflict. GM guidance, five mission seeds, four sample settings, appendix and credits complete book.
source_policy: English original only. No machine translation files.
